hypothesis: The unchanged pooled ETH compression-pullback route may add portfolio cadence if a source-compatible prospective window produces attributable, technically resolved long and short lifecycles with positive after-cost economics that do not depend on one winner.
decision: Continue the isolated report-only observer unchanged. Do not add ETH or relax the canonical breakout-onset requirement. Freeze a new future-only one-blocker diagnostic beginning at 2026-08-17T14:58:00Z; the nine already-observed two-of-three minute evaluations are readiness evidence only and cannot select an outcome horizon.
why_this_revision: The cutoff-bound observer advanced from a maximum readiness of one of three conditions to two of three. Nine minute evaluations lacked only a fresh canonical breakout onset, but they may be repeated observations of the same market episode and produced no order, fill, or PnL evidence.

future_one_blocker_experiment.candidate_definition: exactly two of three frozen entry conditions met with canonical_breakout_onset_absent as the sole blocker
future_one_blocker_experiment.entry: first complete visible-depth executable quote causally available after the completed decision minute
future_one_blocker_experiment.overlap_policy: suppress additional same-side candidates until the primary horizon resolves
future_one_blocker_experiment.minimum_evidence: At least 20 independent candidates with both sides represented, complete exact-depth entry and exit paths, positive primary-horizon mean and median after nominal cost, positive stress mean after removing the largest winner, and no worse stop-path behavior than the frozen route.
future_one_blocker_experiment.failure_behavior: Retain the onset requirement if evidence is negative, one-sided, technically unresolved, or largest-winner dependent. Do not select a descriptive horizon or lower thresholds after observing results.

interpretation.current_evidence: The observer is healthy and has now seen two-of-three readiness, but no fresh canonical breakout onset, no short-side evaluation, no eligible signal, and no resolved lifecycle.
interpretation.comparison_with_no_action: Keeping v53 unchanged remains preferred because neither the frozen ETH route nor the future-only relaxation diagnostic has produced executable evidence.
interpretation.minimum_update_evidence: At least one source-attributable eligible event on each configured route side with complete decision, book, stop path, exact costs, and resolved lifecycle evidence. The separate relaxation experiment must meet its larger preregistered sample contract before any proposal.

risks_and_failure_modes: Seventy-two minute evaluations cover little more than one hour and are not independent trade opportunities.
The nine maximum-readiness rows may be repeated observations of a small number of market episodes.
All observed evaluations were long-side, so bidirectional behavior remains untested.
A fixed-horizon one-blocker diagnostic cannot substitute for the route's native stop and provider exit lifecycle.
Historical edge is small, selection-sensitive, and largest-winner dependent in the opened final block.
Changing a filter during either prospective window would invalidate the comparison.

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep v53 and the frozen ETH observer unchanged; collect the future-only onset one-blocker diagnostic without routing or retuning.
recommendation.Why now: Readiness reached two of three for the first time, creating a specific cadence hypothesis that can be tested prospectively rather than relaxed from intuition.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: The immutable 72-evaluation ETH observer prefix, the v9 preregistration, exact observer identity, readiness distributions, source hashes, and route configuration.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: The canonical onset condition is now the sole blocker in nine minute rows, but independence and after-cost value are unknown.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Observed ETH range/transition conditions with prior compression and a directional pullback but no fresh canonical five-minute breakout onset.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Add ETH immediately, remove onset immediately, select the already-observed best path, stop the observer, or freeze a future-only diagnostic.
recommendation.Expected upside: Determines whether the onset requirement excludes repeatable after-cost opportunity without contaminating v53 capital or the frozen ETH route.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse and correlated episodes, one-sided sampling, fixed-horizon mismatch with native exits, unmeasured funding or slippage, and multiple-testing pressure.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact cutoff, identity, readiness arithmetic, duplicate/future checks, report-only authority, and immutable source-prefix hashing.
recommendation.Validation still required: Future-only candidate collection, exact visible-depth and funding replay, both-side representation, stop-path attribution, realistic costs, largest-winner sensitivity, and native lifecycle comparison.
recommendation.Success metrics: The frozen twenty-candidate contract with positive after-cost mean, median, and largest-winner-removed stress result, plus no degradation of stop behavior.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Any source or identity mismatch invalidates the experiment; negative, one-sided, unresolved, or outlier-dependent evidence retains the current onset requirement.
recommendation.Confidence level: high on observer integrity, medium on the value of the future experiment, low on ETH profitability

next_highest_value_investigation: Continue exact v53 HYPE lifecycle collection as the funded priority; run the ETH future-only onset one-blocker diagnostic in parallel when independent candidates mature.
